seo.title: Freelance software engineer and web developer in Colombia
seo.p1: I'm Brayan Roa, a software engineer, software architect and full stack developer with more than 10 years of experience building systems for companies in many industries. I work as a freelance developer from Bogotá for companies, entrepreneurs and businesses across Colombia, Latin America and beyond.
seo.p2: I take your product from idea to production: I understand your business, design the architecture, build the frontend and backend, deploy it to the cloud and support you after delivery. You talk directly to me, with no middlemen or agencies.
seo.servicesTitle: What I can build for you

services.d: Fast, mobile-first, search-optimized sites that turn visitors into customers.
Management systems, customer portals, inventory, bookings and complete digital products.
WhatsApp assistants that answer 24/7 using your business information.
APIs, integrations, system modernization and cloud architecture on AWS.

seo.stack: Angular, React, Node.js, Java with Spring Boot, PHP with Laravel, Python, SQL and NoSQL databases, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and artificial intelligence (OpenAI, RAG and agents).
seo.whyTitle: Why work with a freelance developer?
seo.why: You get the engineering quality of an enterprise software team with the direct communication and pricing of an independent professional. Every project starts with a written proposal, a fixed price and a delivery date.
